 Raad Adayleh - AP 
 Australia’s soccer friendly next Tuesday against Jordan has been moved to Qatar due to security concerns in the Jordanian capital Amman. Football Australia said Friday that its request to move the match was approved by the Jordan Football Association. Coach Tony Popovic’s Socceroos are currently in Doha where they are set to play Asian champion Qatar on Friday. But their players and staff had made it clear they felt Tuesday’s international against Jordan in the capital Amman should be rescheduled or relocated.
